caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition with a large central heart shape that contains German text written in brown ink. Surrounding the heart are stylized plants and flowers in shades of green, yellow, and orange, with brown stems and outlines. At each of the four corners, there is a bird, each depicted with green, yellow, and brown plumage, a white face, and a black beak and eye. The upper two birds are perched on leafy branches, while the lower two birds stand on the ground amid the plants. The flowers have rounded and pointed petals and are colored primarily in yellow and orange, with green leaves surrounding them. Smaller orange and yellow buds or fruits are present within the foliage. The entire design is bordered by a light brown hand-drawn rectangular frame, and the background outside the main drawing is plain white or off-white. The hand-drawn elements have a naive or folk-art style, and the composition is symmetrical, with pairs of birds and mirrored plant motifs on either side of the heart.
title: Birth Certificate
